Shaquille O'Neal

(Shaq, Diesel, The Big Aristotle, Superman, Shaq Fu, Shaq Daddy, Warrior, The Big Cactus, The Big Shamrock)

Position: Center ▪ Shoots: Right

7-1, 325lb (216cm, 147kg)

Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Shaquille O'Neal?

Shaquille O'Neal is 54 years old.

Where was Shaquille O'Neal born?

Shaquille O'Neal was born in Newark, New Jersey.

When was Shaquille O'Neal born?

Shaquille O'Neal was born on March 6, 1972.

How tall is Shaquille O'Neal?

Shaquille O'Neal is 7-1 (216 cm) tall.

How much did Shaquille O'Neal weigh when playing?

Shaquille O'Neal weighed 325 lbs (147 kg) when playing.

Is Shaquille O'Neal in the Hall of Fame?

Shaquille O'Neal was inducted to the Hall of Fame as a Player in 2016 (Full List) .

When was Shaquille O'Neal drafted?

Shaquille O'Neal was drafted by Orlando Magic, 1st round (1st pick, 1st overall), 1992 NBA Draft.

What position did Shaquille O'Neal play?

Center.

When did Shaquille O'Neal retire?

Shaquille O'Neal last played in 2011.

What is Shaquille O'Neal's net worth?

Shaquille O'Neal made at least $292,198,327 playing professional basketball.

How much did Shaquille O'Neal make?

Shaquille O'Neal made $27,696,430 in 2005.

What did Shaquille O'Neal average?

Shaquille O'Neal averaged 23.7 points, 10.9 rebounds, and 2.5 assists per game.

How many rings does Shaquille O'Neal have?

Shaquille O'Neal won 4 championships.

What schools did Shaquille O'Neal attend?

Shaquille O'Neal attended Cole in San Antonio, Texas and LSU.

What are Shaquille O'Neal's nicknames?

Shaq, Diesel, The Big Aristotle, Superman, Shaq Fu, Shaq Daddy, Warrior, The Big Cactus, The Big Shamrock are nicknames for Shaquille O'Neal.
